Samsø Sundheds og Akuthus is a small healthcare facility located on the Danish island of Samsø. It is documented in the annual report of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP), which tracks clinical quality indicators for atrial fibrillation patients across Denmark's five regions for the period of July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023 [^src1]. 

The facility's primary significance in the corpus is statistical rather than clinical. In the report's empirical results tables, Samsø Sundheds og Akuthus recorded a zero-result (0 out of 7 patients) for the tracked cardiovascular indicators [^src1]. Due to this extremely small sample size, the calculated confidence interval is exceptionally wide, ranging from 0.0% to 41.0% [^src1]. The report's reading guide and methodology sections use data points like this to illustrate the inherent challenges of performing statistical analysis, interpreting confidence intervals, and benchmarking clinical quality on very small patient populations within the Danish healthcare system [^src1].
